# Overview

This R Markdown document reproduces the main capsule sponge copy-number analyses, diagnostic modelling, sensitivity analyses, and microdissected ESD tissue analyses reported in the  manuscript.

## Data requirements

This analysis requires participant-derived sequencing and clinical data that are
not distributed with this public code repository. Instructions for obtaining the
controlled-access datasets and the expected input-file structure are provided in
`data/README.md`.


```{r}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
echo = TRUE,
message = FALSE,
warning = FALSE
)
set.seed(123)  # For reproducibility

```

```{r}
# ---- Libraries ----
suppressPackageStartupMessages({

library(ggsignif)

library(scales)

})

```

# 0. Define project structure
```{r project-structure}
# This R Markdown file is designed to be run from the project root directory.
# Expected structure:
#   data/
#     capsule_sponge_50kb_segmented.tsv
#     clinical_metadata.tsv
#     esd_segments.tsv
#   results/
#   figures/

data_dir <- "data"
results_dir <- "results"
fig_dir <- "figures"
tables_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "tables")
gee_output_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "sensitivity_analyses")

dir.create(results_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(fig_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(tables_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(gee_output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

required_input_files <- c(
  file.path(data_dir, "capsule_sponge_50kb_segmented.tsv"),
  file.path(data_dir, "clinical_metadata.tsv"),
  file.path(data_dir, "esd_segments.tsv")
)

missing_input_files <- required_input_files[!file.exists(required_input_files)]

if (length(missing_input_files) > 0) {
  stop(
    "The following required input files are missing:\n",
    paste(missing_input_files, collapse = "\n"),
    "\n\nPlease run this script from the project root directory."
  )
}

cat("Input files found:\n")
print(required_input_files)
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# 1. Load Capsule sponge shallow WGS segment data + metadata
# ==============================================================================

# 50 kb segmented CN data for Capsule sponge (each row = genomic bin; wide format)
sponge_CN_50kb_raw <- read_tsv(
  file.path(data_dir, "capsule_sponge_50kb_segmented.tsv"),
  col_types = cols()
) %>%
  mutate(
    chromosomal_arm = paste0("chr", chromosomal_arm)
  ) %>%
  arrange(chromosome)

# Long format: per-bin CN per sample
sponge_CN_50kb_long <- sponge_CN_50kb_raw %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches("^SLX"),
    names_to = "sequencing_ID",
    values_to = "segmented_CN"
  )

# Clinical metadata for Capsule sponge libraries/specimens
clinical_df <- read_tsv(
  file.path(data_dir, "clinical_metadata.tsv"),
  col_types = cols()
) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    sequencing_ID,
    specimen_ID,
    case_ID,
    age,
    sex,
    bmi,
    chest_rth,
    group,
    smoking_binary,
    endoscopy_outcome_binarized,
    endoscopy_outcome_trichotomize,
    cytosponge_definite_sq_atypia,
    p53_staining_binarized
  )


# Annotate per-bin CN with specimen-level metadata
sponge_CN_50kb_long_annot <- sponge_CN_50kb_long %>%
  inner_join(clinical_df, by = "sequencing_ID") %>%
  dplyr::select(
    sequencing_ID,
    specimen_ID,
    case_ID,
    chromosome,
    start,
    end,
    chromosomal_arm,
    segmented_CN,
    group,
    endoscopy_outcome_binarized,
    endoscopy_outcome_trichotomize
  ) 

# ==============================================================================
# 2. Call per-bin alteration status using robust arm-wise control ranges
#    Threshold = median ± 1.5×IQR within healthy controls
# ==============================================================================

control_bins <- sponge_CN_50kb_long_annot %>%
  filter(group == "control")

arm_ref_stats <- control_bins %>%
  group_by(chromosomal_arm) %>%
  summarise(
    median_value = median(segmented_CN, na.rm = TRUE),
    iqr_value    = IQR(segmented_CN, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    lower_bound = median_value - 1.5 * iqr_value,
    upper_bound = median_value + 1.5 * iqr_value
  )

sponge_CN_50kb_long_annot <- sponge_CN_50kb_long_annot %>%
  left_join(arm_ref_stats, by = "chromosomal_arm") %>%
  mutate(
    is_altered = if_else(
      segmented_CN < lower_bound | segmented_CN > upper_bound,
      "altered",
      "normal"
    ),
    outcome_tri_category = case_when(
      endoscopy_outcome_trichotomize == 0   ~ "normal",
      endoscopy_outcome_trichotomize == 0.5 ~ "benign_conditions",
      endoscopy_outcome_trichotomize == 1   ~ "IEN_early_cancer"
    )
  )

saveRDS(sponge_CN_50kb_long_annot,
        file.path(results_dir, "capsulesponge_50kb_long_annot.rds"))

# ==============================================================================
# 3. Genome-wide CNA burden per specimen
#    - Continuous: proportion of altered genome-wide
#    - Binary: "High burden" if above 95th percentile of controls
# ==============================================================================

gw_burden_df <- sponge_CN_50kb_long_annot %>%
  group_by(specimen_ID, outcome_tri_category, group) %>%
  summarise(
    altered_segments = sum(is_altered == "altered"),
    total_segments   = n(),
    genome_wide_CNA_burden =
      altered_segments / total_segments,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

control_gw <- gw_burden_df %>%
  filter(group == "control")

gw_threshold <- quantile(
  control_gw$genome_wide_CNA_burden,
  probs = 0.95,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

gw_burden_df <- gw_burden_df %>%
  mutate(
    genome_wide_CNA_burden_binary = if_else(
      genome_wide_CNA_burden >= gw_threshold,
      "High burden",
      "Low burden"
    )
  )

unique(gw_burden_df$outcome_tri_category)

saveRDS(gw_burden_df,
        file.path(results_dir, "capsulesponge_gw_burden_df.rds"))

# ==============================================================================
# 4. Aggregate 50 kb bins -> chromosome-arm summaries per specimen
#    (median log2 relative copy number per arm)
# ==============================================================================

arm_level_CN <- sponge_CN_50kb_long %>%
  group_by(sequencing_ID, chromosomal_arm) %>%
  summarise(
    segmented_CN = median(segmented_CN, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

arm_level_annot <- arm_level_CN %>%
  inner_join(clinical_df, by = "sequencing_ID") %>%
  inner_join(
    gw_burden_df %>%
      dplyr::select(
        specimen_ID,
        genome_wide_CNA_burden,
        genome_wide_CNA_burden_binary,
        outcome_tri_category
      ),
    by = "specimen_ID"
  )

saveRDS(arm_level_annot,
        file.path(results_dir, "capsulesponge_arm_level_annot.rds"))

# ==============================================================================
# 5. Figure: Arm-level relative CN across outcome groups
#    Faceted scatter/jitter by outcome group
# ==============================================================================

# ---- Factor levels (x-axis order) ----
arm_order <- c(
  "chr1p","chr1q","chr2p","chr2q","chr3p","chr3q","chr4p","chr4q",
  "chr5p","chr5q","chr6p","chr6q","chr7p","chr7q","chr8p","chr8q",
  "chr9p","chr9q","chr10p","chr10q","chr11p","chr11q","chr12p","chr12q",
  "chr13q","chr14q","chr15q","chr16p","chr16q","chr17p","chr17q",
  "chr18p","chr18q","chr19p","chr19q","chr20p","chr20q","chr21q","chr22q"
)

# ---- Build plotting dataframe ----
plot_df <- arm_level_annot %>%
  mutate(
    chromosomal_arm = factor(chromosomal_arm, levels = arm_order),
    OutcomeGroup = factor(
      as.character(endoscopy_outcome_trichotomize),
      levels = c("0","0.5","1"),
      labels = c("Normal","Benign","IEN/early cancer")
    )
  )

# ---- Aesthetics ----
cols_outcome <- c(
  "Normal"           = "#4DAF4A",
  "Benign"           = "#377EB8",
  "IEN/early cancer" = "#E41A1C"
)

thin_every <- 2

x_lab_fun <- function(x) {
  idx <- seq_along(x)
  ifelse(idx %% thin_every == 1, x, "")
}

# ---- Plot ----
p_armCN <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(
    x = chromosomal_arm,
    y = segmented_CN,
    colour = OutcomeGroup
  )
) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey35", linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(
    alpha = 0.55,
    size = 1.2,
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.18, height = 0, seed = 123)
  ) +
  facet_grid(. ~ OutcomeGroup, scales = "fixed") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cols_outcome, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE, labels = x_lab_fun) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-0.5, 0.5),
    breaks = seq(-0.5, 0.5, 0.25),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
  ) +
  labs(x = "Chromosome arm", y = "Relative copy number") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
theme(
  panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey88", linewidth = 0.45),
  panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "grey92", linewidth = 0.35),
  panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
  panel.border       = element_blank(),
  panel.spacing.x    = unit(0.6, "lines"),
  axis.line          = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
  axis.title         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
  axis.text.y        = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
  axis.text.x        = element_text(
    angle = 90,
    vjust = 0.5,
    hjust = 1,
    face = "bold",
    size = 12
  ),
  strip.background   = element_blank(),
  strip.text         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12)
)

print(p_armCN)

# ---- Save (PDF + PNG) ----
ggsave(
  file.path(fig_dir, "Figure_2A.pdf"),
  p_armCN,
  width = 13.5,
  height = 4.2,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 600,
  device = cairo_pdf
)

ggsave(
  file.path(fig_dir, "Figure_2A.png"),
  p_armCN,
  width = 13.5,
  height = 4.2,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)

# ==============================================================================
# 6. Genome-wide CNA burden visualisation:
#    (A) violin/boxplot + Kruskal-Wallis + Dunn
#    (B) horizontal bar plot of % High burden per group
# ==============================================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)
library(readr)
library(rstatix)
library(ggpubr)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6.1 Prepare plotting/statistics dataframe
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

diagnostic_labels <- c(
  "Normal",
  "Benign",
  "IEN/early cancer"
)

standardise_outcome_tri <- function(x) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    as.character(x) %in% c("normal", "Normal") ~ "Normal",
    as.character(x) %in% c("benign_conditions", "Benign") ~ "Benign",
    as.character(x) %in% c("IEN_early_cancer", "IEN/early cancer") ~ "IEN/early cancer",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

burden_plot_df <- gw_burden_df %>%
  mutate(
    OutcomeGroup = standardise_outcome_tri(outcome_tri_category),
    OutcomeGroup = factor(
      OutcomeGroup,
      levels = diagnostic_labels
    ),
    genome_wide_CNA_burden_binary = factor(
      genome_wide_CNA_burden_binary,
      levels = c("Low burden", "High burden")
    )
  )

# Add case_ID if gw_burden_df does not already contain it
if (!"case_ID" %in% names(burden_plot_df)) {
  burden_plot_df <- burden_plot_df %>%
    left_join(
      clinical_df %>%
        distinct(specimen_ID, case_ID),
      by = "specimen_ID"
    )
}

cols_groups <- c(
  "Normal" = "#4DAF4A",
  "Benign" = "#377EB8",
  "IEN/early cancer" = "#E41A1C"
)

order_lvls <- levels(burden_plot_df$OutcomeGroup)

cat("\n--- GW-CNA burden scroll-set counts ---\n")
print(table(burden_plot_df$OutcomeGroup, useNA = "ifany"))

if (any(is.na(burden_plot_df$OutcomeGroup))) {
  stop("Some outcome_tri_category values did not map to OutcomeGroup. Check unique(gw_burden_df$outcome_tri_category).")
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6.2 Use existing binary GW-CNA burden threshold
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# gw_threshold was calculated earlier as the 95th percentile of GW-CNA burden
# in healthy/control samples.
if (!exists("gw_threshold")) {
  stop("gw_threshold does not exist. Please calculate it earlier before running Section 6.")
}

thr_line <- as.numeric(gw_threshold)

cat("\n--- GW-CNA burden threshold, 95th percentile of healthy/control samples ---\n")
print(thr_line)

cat("\n--- Binary GW-CNA burden counts ---\n")
print(table(burden_plot_df$OutcomeGroup, burden_plot_df$genome_wide_CNA_burden_binary))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6.3 Summary statistics
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

gw_burden_summary <- burden_plot_df %>%
  group_by(OutcomeGroup) %>%
  summarise(
    n_scrollsets = n(),
    n_patients = n_distinct(case_ID),
    median_burden = median(genome_wide_CNA_burden, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_burden = mean(genome_wide_CNA_burden, na.rm = TRUE),
    q1_burden = quantile(genome_wide_CNA_burden, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q3_burden = quantile(genome_wide_CNA_burden, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    iqr_burden = IQR(genome_wide_CNA_burden, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_burden = min(genome_wide_CNA_burden, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_burden = max(genome_wide_CNA_burden, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

gw_burden_summary_for_text <- gw_burden_summary %>%
  mutate(
    median_iqr_text = sprintf(
      "%.3f [%.3f]",
      median_burden,
      iqr_burden
    ),
    q1_q3_text = sprintf(
      "%.3f–%.3f",
      q1_burden,
      q3_burden
    )
  )

cat("\n--- GW-CNA burden summary by diagnostic group ---\n")
print(gw_burden_summary_for_text, n = Inf, width = Inf)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6.4 Kruskal-Wallis test across diagnostic groups
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

kw_burden <- kruskal.test(
  genome_wide_CNA_burden ~ OutcomeGroup,
  data = burden_plot_df
)

kw_burden_tbl <- tibble(
  test = "Kruskal-Wallis",
  variable = "genome_wide_CNA_burden",
  statistic = unname(kw_burden$statistic),
  df = unname(kw_burden$parameter),
  p_value = kw_burden$p.value,
  p_adj_BH = p.adjust(kw_burden$p.value, method = "BH")
)

cat("\n--- GW-CNA burden Kruskal-Wallis test ---\n")
print(kw_burden_tbl)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6.5 Dunn post-hoc tests with BH/FDR adjustment
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

dunn_burden <- burden_plot_df %>%
  rstatix::dunn_test(
    genome_wide_CNA_burden ~ OutcomeGroup,
    p.adjust.method = "BH"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p = as.numeric(p),
    p.adj = as.numeric(p.adj)
  )

cat("\n--- GW-CNA burden Dunn post-hoc tests ---\n")
print(dunn_burden, n = Inf)

dunn_keep <- dunn_burden %>%
  filter(group1 == "IEN/early cancer" | group2 == "IEN/early cancer") %>%
  mutate(
    group1 = if_else(group1 == "IEN/early cancer", group2, group1),
    group2 = "IEN/early cancer"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(.y., group1, group2, p.adj, p.adj.signif) %>%
  arrange(match(group1, c("Normal", "Benign"))) %>%
  mutate(
    y.position = c(1.02, 1.07),
    group1 = factor(group1, levels = order_lvls),
    group2 = factor(group2, levels = order_lvls)
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6.6 Binary GW-CNA burden percentages and chi-square test
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

bar_df <- burden_plot_df %>%
  count(OutcomeGroup, genome_wide_CNA_burden_binary, name = "n") %>%
  complete(
    OutcomeGroup,
    genome_wide_CNA_burden_binary = factor(
      c("Low burden", "High burden"),
      levels = c("Low burden", "High burden")
    ),
    fill = list(n = 0)
  ) %>%
  group_by(OutcomeGroup) %>%
  mutate(
    total = sum(n),
    pct = 100 * n / total
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

bar_high_df <- bar_df %>%
  filter(genome_wide_CNA_burden_binary == "High burden") %>%
  mutate(
    group_lab = factor(as.character(OutcomeGroup), levels = order_lvls)
  ) %>%
  arrange(group_lab)

cat("\n--- Binary GW-CNA high-burden summary ---\n")
print(bar_high_df, n = Inf)

binary_tab <- table(
  burden_plot_df$OutcomeGroup,
  burden_plot_df$genome_wide_CNA_burden_binary
)

cat("\n--- Binary GW-CNA burden contingency table ---\n")
print(binary_tab)

chisq_binary_burden <- chisq.test(binary_tab)

chisq_binary_burden_tbl <- tibble(
  test = "Chi-square",
  variable = "genome_wide_CNA_burden_binary",
  statistic = unname(chisq_binary_burden$statistic),
  df = unname(chisq_binary_burden$parameter),
  p_value = chisq_binary_burden$p.value
)

cat("\n--- Binary GW-CNA burden chi-square test ---\n")
print(chisq_binary_burden_tbl)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6.7 Formatted p-values 
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

format_p_for_text <- function(p) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(p) ~ NA_character_,
    p < 0.001 ~ formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 2),
    TRUE ~ formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 4)
  )
}

kw_burden_for_text <- kw_burden_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    p_value_text = format_p_for_text(p_value),
    p_adj_BH_text = format_p_for_text(p_adj_BH)
  )

dunn_burden_for_text <- dunn_burden %>%
  mutate(
    p_text = format_p_for_text(p),
    p_adj_text = format_p_for_text(p.adj)
  ) %>%
  select(
    group1,
    group2,
    statistic,
    p,
    p.adj,
    p_text,
    p_adj_text,
    p.adj.signif
  )

chisq_binary_burden_for_text <- chisq_binary_burden_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    p_value_text = format_p_for_text(p_value)
  )

cat("\n--- Formatted GW-CNA burden Kruskal-Wallis result ---\n")
print(kw_burden_for_text)

cat("\n--- Formatted GW-CNA burden Dunn tests ---\n")
print(dunn_burden_for_text, n = Inf)

cat("\n--- Formatted binary chi-square result ---\n")
print(chisq_binary_burden_for_text)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6.8 Panel A: continuous GW-CNA burden
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

p_top <- ggplot(
  burden_plot_df,
  aes(
    x = OutcomeGroup,
    y = genome_wide_CNA_burden,
    fill = OutcomeGroup
  )
) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = thr_line,
    linetype = "dotted",
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 0.55,
    y = thr_line + 0.02,
    label = "GW-CNA threshold (95th percentile of controls)",
    hjust = 0,
    size = 3.6,
    fontface = "italic"
  ) +
  geom_violin(
    trim = TRUE,
    alpha = 0.70,
    colour = NA
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.16,
    alpha = 0.85,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    linewidth = 0.6,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.15,
    alpha = 0.45,
    size = 1.2,
    colour = "grey25"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols_groups, guide = "none") +
  ggpubr::stat_pvalue_manual(
    dunn_keep,
    mapping = aes(
      x = group1,
      xend = group2,
      y = y.position,
      label = p.adj.signif
    ),
    tip.length = 0.01,
    size = 4,
    bracket.size = 0.6,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 1.02,
    y = 1.06,
    label = paste0(
      "Kruskal-Wallis FDR P = ",
      formatC(kw_burden_tbl$p_adj_BH, format = "e", digits = 2)
    ),
    hjust = 0,
    size = 4.1,
    fontface = "italic"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE, limits = order_lvls) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = c(0, 1.08),
    clip = "off"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Proportion of genome altered",
    title = "Genome-wide CNA burden (continuous)"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey88", linewidth = 0.45),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6.9 Panel B: percentage high GW-CNA burden
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

p_bot <- ggplot(
  bar_high_df,
  aes(
    x = pct,
    y = group_lab,
    fill = OutcomeGroup
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    width = 0.6,
    colour = NA
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", pct)),
    hjust = -0.15,
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 4.1
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols_groups, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 100),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.10))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "% genomically unstable specimens",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Genome-wide CNA burden (binary)"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "grey88", linewidth = 0.45),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6.10 Combine panels
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

p_top_no_title <- p_top +
  labs(y = NULL) +
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_blank()
  )

# ==============================================================================
# 7B. Key arm alteration frequency
#     Frequency of altered chr2q, chr3q, chr9p and chr11q across outcome groups
# ==============================================================================

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# For each specimen and chromosome arm, calculate the proportion of 50 kb bins
# classified as altered. 
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

key_arms <- c("chr2q", "chr3q", "chr9p", "chr11q")

# STEP 1: Calculate proportion of altered 50 kb bins within each arm/specimen
arm_level_alteration_density <- sponge_CN_50kb_long_annot %>%
  group_by(specimen_ID, chromosomal_arm, outcome_tri_category) %>%
  summarise(
    altered_segments = sum(is_altered == "altered", na.rm = TRUE),
    total_segments = n(),
    alteration_density = altered_segments / total_segments,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# STEP 2: Use the control-derived threshold from the GW-CNA burden analysis
arm_alteration_threshold <- gw_threshold

print(arm_alteration_threshold)

# STEP 3: Classify each key arm as altered
arm_alteration_status <- arm_level_alteration_density %>%
  filter(chromosomal_arm %in% key_arms) %>%
  mutate(
    outcome_tri_category = factor(
      outcome_tri_category,
      levels = c("normal", "benign_conditions", "IEN_early_cancer")
    ),
    is_arm_altered = if_else(
      alteration_density >= arm_alteration_threshold,
      1L,
      0L
    )
  )

# STEP 4: Calculate alteration frequency by chromosome arm and outcome group
arm_alteration_frequency <- arm_alteration_status %>%
  group_by(chromosomal_arm, outcome_tri_category) %>%
  summarise(
    samples_with_alteration = sum(is_arm_altered == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_samples = n_distinct(specimen_ID),
    frequency = samples_with_alteration / total_samples * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(arm_alteration_frequency, n = Inf)

# STEP 5: Chi-square test for alteration status across outcome groups, per arm
chi_square_results <- arm_alteration_status %>%
  filter(chromosomal_arm %in% key_arms) %>%
  group_by(chromosomal_arm) %>%
  summarise(
    chisq_test = list(
      chisq.test(table(is_arm_altered, outcome_tri_category))
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    statistic = map_dbl(chisq_test, ~ unname(.x$statistic)),
    p_value = map_dbl(chisq_test, ~ .x$p.value)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(chromosomal_arm, statistic, p_value)

print(chi_square_results, n = Inf)

# STEP 6: Count samples with at least one altered key arm
sample_summary <- arm_alteration_status %>%
  group_by(specimen_ID, outcome_tri_category) %>%
  summarise(
    has_at_least_one_key_arm_altered = any(is_arm_altered == 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(outcome_tri_category) %>%
  summarise(
    samples_with_at_least_one_key_arm_altered =
      sum(has_at_least_one_key_arm_altered),
    total_samples = n_distinct(specimen_ID),
    pct_with_at_least_one =
      samples_with_at_least_one_key_arm_altered / total_samples * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(sample_summary, n = Inf)

# STEP 7: Key-arm frequency table
freq_text_table <- arm_alteration_frequency %>%
  mutate(
    outcome_label = factor(
      outcome_tri_category,
      levels = c("IEN_early_cancer", "benign_conditions", "normal"),
      labels = c("IEN/early cancer", "Benign", "Normal")
    ),
    chromosomal_arm = factor(
      chromosomal_arm,
      levels = c("chr3q", "chr9p", "chr2q", "chr11q")
    ),
    freq_label = paste0(
      sprintf("%.1f%%", frequency),
      " (", samples_with_alteration, "/", total_samples, ")"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    chromosomal_arm,
    outcome_label,
    freq_label,
    samples_with_alteration,
    total_samples,
    frequency
  ) %>%
  arrange(chromosomal_arm, outcome_label)

print(freq_text_table, n = Inf)

freq_text_table_wide <- freq_text_table %>%
  dplyr::select(chromosomal_arm, outcome_label, freq_label) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = outcome_label,
    values_from = freq_label
  )

manuscript_key_arm_table <- freq_text_table_wide %>%
  left_join(
    chi_square_results %>%
      mutate(
        chromosomal_arm = factor(
          chromosomal_arm,
          levels = c("chr3q", "chr9p", "chr2q", "chr11q")
        ),
        chi_square = round(statistic, 1),
        p_formatted = formatC(p_value, format = "e", digits = 2)
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(chromosomal_arm, chi_square, p_formatted),
    by = "chromosomal_arm"
  ) %>%
  arrange(chromosomal_arm)

print(manuscript_key_arm_table, n = Inf)

# STEP 8: Harmonise labels and order for plotting
plot_freq <- arm_alteration_frequency %>%
  mutate(
    chromosomal_arm = factor(

      labels = c("Normal", "Benign", "IEN/early cancer")
    ),
    pct_label = paste0(round(frequency, 1), "%")
  )

cols <- c(

# STEP 9: Plot
p_key_arm_frequency <- ggplot(

print(p_key_arm_frequency)

# STEP 10: Save
ggsave(

# ==============================================================================
# 8. Genome-wide burden vs key-arm instability (correlation)
# ==============================================================================

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# --- settings ---
# Expect: key_arms <- c("chr2q","chr3q","chr9p","chr11q")

custom_colors <- c(
  "Normal"           = "#4DAF4A",
  "Benign"           = "#377EB8",
  "IEN/early cancer" = "#E41A1C"
)

# --- 1) Per-arm instability (sum of |log2 CN| across 50kb bins) ---
arm_instab <- sponge_CN_50kb_long_annot %>%
  filter(chromosomal_arm %in% key_arms) %>%
  mutate(abs_cn = abs(segmented_CN)) %>%
  group_by(specimen_ID, chromosomal_arm) %>%
  summarise(
    arm_instability_score = sum(abs_cn, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --- 2) Specimen-level cumulative instability (mean across key arms) ---
instability_df <- arm_instab %>%
  group_by(specimen_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_arm_instability = mean(arm_instability_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    gw_burden_df %>%
      dplyr::select(
        specimen_ID,
        outcome_tri_category,
        genome_wide_CNA_burden
      ),
    by = "specimen_ID"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    OutcomeGroup = factor(
      outcome_tri_category,
      levels = c("normal", "benign_conditions", "IEN_early_cancer"),
      labels = c("Normal", "Benign", "IEN/early cancer")
    )
  )

# --- 3) Correlation (Pearson) ---
cor_res <- cor.test(
  instability_df$genome_wide_CNA_burden,
  instability_df$mean_arm_instability,
  method = "pearson"
)

print(cor_res)

r_lab <- if (cor_res$p.value < 0.001) {
  sprintf(
    "r = %.2f, P < 0.001",
    unname(cor_res$estimate)
  )
} else {
  sprintf(
    "r = %.2f, P = %.3g",
    unname(cor_res$estimate),
    cor_res$p.value
  )
}
# --- 4) Plot ---
x_rng <- range(instability_df$genome_wide_CNA_burden, na.rm = TRUE)
y_rng <- range(instability_df$mean_arm_instability, na.rm = TRUE)

x_range <- range(instability_df$genome_wide_CNA_burden, na.rm = TRUE)
y_range <- range(instability_df$mean_arm_instability, na.rm = TRUE)

p_corr <- ggplot(
  instability_df,
  aes(
    x = genome_wide_CNA_burden,
    y = mean_arm_instability,
    color = OutcomeGroup
  )
) +
  geom_point(size = 4, shape = 21, fill = "white", stroke = 1) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    se = TRUE,
    color = "black",
    linetype = "solid",
    size = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = custom_colors) +
  labs(
    x = "Genome-wide CNA burden",
    y = "Cumulative instability in key arms",
    title = NULL,
    color = NULL
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = max(x_rng) * 0.02,
    y = max(y_rng) * 0.98,
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 1,
    label = r_lab,
    fontface = "italic",
    size = 4
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "grey92", linewidth = 0.35),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey88", linewidth = 0.45),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    panel.border       = element_blank(),
    axis.line          = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
    axis.title         = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text          = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position    = "top"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, max(y_range) * 1.1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.05))
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, max(x_range) * 1.1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.05))
  )

print(p_corr)

# --- 5) Export ---

# ==============================================================================
# 9. Diagnostic modelling with cross-validation
#    Binomial logistic regression models evaluated using repeated stratified
#    5-fold cross-validation
# ==============================================================================

library(caret)
library(pROC)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Prepare modelling dataframe
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

model_df <- arm_level_annot %>%
  dplyr::select(
    sequencing_ID,
    specimen_ID,
    case_ID,
    chromosomal_arm,
    segmented_CN,
    endoscopy_outcome_binarized,
    endoscopy_outcome_trichotomize,
    genome_wide_CNA_burden,
    genome_wide_CNA_burden_binary,
    age,
    sex,
    bmi,
    chest_rth,
    smoking_binary,
    cytosponge_definite_sq_atypia,
    p53_staining_binarized
  ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = chromosomal_arm,
    values_from = segmented_CN
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    endoscopy_outcome_binarized = factor(
      endoscopy_outcome_binarized,
      levels = c(0, 1),
      labels = c("X0", "X1")
    ),
    sex = factor(sex),
    chest_rth = factor(chest_rth),
    cytosponge_definite_sq_atypia = factor(cytosponge_definite_sq_atypia),
    p53_staining_binarized = factor(p53_staining_binarized),
    genome_wide_CNA_burden_binary = factor(genome_wide_CNA_burden_binary),
    bmi = as.numeric(bmi)
  )

# Check missingness in candidate covariates
colMeans(is.na(model_df[, c(
  "age",
  "sex",
  "bmi",
  "chest_rth",
  "cytosponge_definite_sq_atypia",
  "p53_staining_binarized",
  "genome_wide_CNA_burden",
  "genome_wide_CNA_burden_binary",
  "chr2q",
  "chr3q",
  "chr9p",
  "chr11q"
)]))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Define outcome and predictor sets
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

target <- "endoscopy_outcome_binarized"

copy_number_continuous <- c(
  "chr9p",
  "chr2q",
  "chr3q",
  "chr11q",
  "genome_wide_CNA_burden"
)

copy_number_binary <- c(
  "chr9p",
  "chr2q",
  "chr3q",
  "chr11q",
  "genome_wide_CNA_burden_binary"
)

pathology_vars <- c(
  "cytosponge_definite_sq_atypia",
  "p53_staining_binarized"
)

all_model_vars <- unique(c(
  target,
  copy_number_continuous,
  copy_number_binary,
  pathology_vars
))

# Use a common complete-case analysis set for fair comparison across models
model_df_cc <- model_df %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(all_model_vars)) %>%
  tidyr::drop_na()

table(model_df_cc[[target]])

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Cross-validation setup
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

extendedSummary <- function(data, lev = NULL, model = NULL) {
  
  roc_obj <- pROC::roc(
    response = data$obs,
    predictor = data[, lev[2]],
    levels = rev(lev),
    quiet = TRUE
  )
  
  youden <- pROC::coords(
    roc_obj,
    x = "best",
    best.method = "youden",
    ret = c("threshold", "sensitivity", "specificity"),
    transpose = FALSE
  )
  
  threshold <- as.numeric(youden$threshold)
  
  predicted <- ifelse(
    data[, lev[2]] > threshold,
    lev[2],
    lev[1]
  )
  
  cm <- caret::confusionMatrix(
    factor(predicted, levels = lev),
    factor(data$obs, levels = lev),
    positive = lev[2]
  )
  
  ppv <- as.numeric(cm$byClass["Pos Pred Value"])
  npv <- as.numeric(cm$byClass["Neg Pred Value"])
  sens <- as.numeric(youden$sensitivity)
  spec <- as.numeric(youden$specificity)
  
  f1 <- ifelse(
    is.na(ppv) | is.na(sens) | (ppv + sens) == 0,
    NA_real_,
    2 * (ppv * sens) / (ppv + sens)
  )
  
  c(
    ROC = as.numeric(roc_obj$auc),
    Sens = sens,
    Spec = spec,
    YoudenIndex = threshold,
    PPV = ppv,
    NPV = npv,
    F1 = f1
  )
}

set.seed(567)

fold_index <- caret::createMultiFolds(
  y = model_df_cc[[target]],
  k = 5,
  times = 10
)

cv_control <- caret::trainControl(
  method = "repeatedcv",
  number = 5,
  repeats = 10,
  index = fold_index,
  classProbs = TRUE,
  summaryFunction = extendedSummary,
  savePredictions = "final"
)

cv_ctrl <- trainControl(
  method          = "repeatedcv",
  number          = 5,
  repeats         = 10,
  classProbs      = TRUE,
  summaryFunction = extendedSummary,
  savePredictions = "final",
  allowParallel   = TRUE
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Extract cross-validation metrics
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

calculate_ci <- function(values, conf_level = 0.95) {
  values <- values[!is.na(values)]
  n <- length(values)
  mean_value <- mean(values)
  error <- qt((1 + conf_level) / 2, df = n - 1) * sd(values) / sqrt(n)
  
  c(
    mean = mean_value,
    lower = mean_value - error,
    upper = mean_value + error
  )
}

extract_metrics <- function(model) {
  
  resamples <- model$resample
  
  accuracy_values <- tapply(
    model$pred$pred == model$pred$obs,
    model$pred$Resample,
    mean
  )
  
  list(
    Sensitivity = calculate_ci(resamples$Sens),
    Specificity = calculate_ci(resamples$Spec),
    PPV = calculate_ci(resamples$PPV),
    NPV = calculate_ci(resamples$NPV),
    F1 = calculate_ci(resamples$F1),
    Accuracy = calculate_ci(accuracy_values)
  )
}

print_results <- function(model_name, metrics) {
  cat("\n", model_name, " Model Results:\n", sep = "")
  cat(sprintf(
    "Sensitivity: %.3f (95%% CI %.3f–%.3f)\n",
    metrics$Sensitivity["mean"],
    metrics$Sensitivity["lower"],
    metrics$Sensitivity["upper"]
  ))
  cat(sprintf(
    "Specificity: %.3f (95%% CI %.3f–%.3f)\n",
    metrics$Specificity["mean"],
    metrics$Specificity["lower"],
    metrics$Specificity["upper"]
  ))
  cat(sprintf(
    "PPV: %.3f (95%% CI %.3f–%.3f)\n",
    metrics$PPV["mean"],
    metrics$PPV["lower"],
    metrics$PPV["upper"]
  ))
  cat(sprintf(
    "NPV: %.3f (95%% CI %.3f–%.3f)\n",
    metrics$NPV["mean"],
    metrics$NPV["lower"],
    metrics$NPV["upper"]
  ))
  cat(sprintf(
    "F1 Score: %.3f (95%% CI %.3f–%.3f)\n",
    metrics$F1["mean"],
    metrics$F1["lower"],
    metrics$F1["upper"]
  ))
  cat(sprintf(
    "Accuracy: %.3f (95%% CI %.3f–%.3f)\n",
    metrics$Accuracy["mean"],
    metrics$Accuracy["lower"],
    metrics$Accuracy["upper"]
  ))
}

performance_metrics <- lapply(model_list, extract_metrics)

for (model_name in names(performance_metrics)) {
  print_results(model_name, performance_metrics[[model_name]])
}


# Helper: ROC/AUC from pooled out-of-fold predictions
roc_from_caret <- function(mod, pos_class_col = "X1") {
  
  preds <- mod$pred
  
  if (!is.null(mod$bestTune)) {
    for (param in names(mod$bestTune)) {
      preds <- preds[preds[[param]] == mod$bestTune[[param]], ]
    }
  }
  
  preds$obs <- factor(preds$obs, levels = c("X0", "X1"))
  
  roc_obj <- pROC::roc(
    response = preds$obs,
    predictor = preds[[pos_class_col]],
    levels = c("X0", "X1"),
    direction = "<",
    ci = TRUE,
    quiet = TRUE
  )
  
  list(
    roc = roc_obj,
    auc = as.numeric(pROC::auc(roc_obj)),
    ci = as.numeric(pROC::ci.auc(roc_obj, method = "delong"))
  )
}

main_auc_tbl <- purrr::imap_dfr(model_list, function(mod, nm) {
  roc_info <- roc_from_caret(mod)
  tibble::tibble(
    Model = nm,
    AUC = roc_info$auc,
    AUC_lower = roc_info$ci[1],
    AUC_upper = roc_info$ci[3]
  )
})

library(dplyr)
library(pROC)
library(caret)
library(readr)
library(tibble)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 10.1 Create lookup table linking caret rowIndex to specimen and patient IDs
#      This must match the exact rows used for model training.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

model_lookup_base <- model_df %>%
  mutate(original_row = row_number()) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    original_row,
    sequencing_ID,
    specimen_ID,
    case_ID,
    all_of(all_model_vars)
  ) %>%
  tidyr::drop_na(all_of(all_model_vars))

id_lookup_row <- model_lookup_base %>%
  mutate(rowIndex = row_number()) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    rowIndex,
    sequencing_ID,
    specimen_ID,
    case_ID,
    endoscopy_outcome_binarized
  )

# Sanity checks: lookup rows should match modelling rows
stopifnot(nrow(id_lookup_row) == nrow(model_df_cc))
stopifnot(all(id_lookup_row$endoscopy_outcome_binarized == model_df_cc[[target]]))

table(id_lookup_row$endoscopy_outcome_binarized)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 10.2 Function to aggregate out-of-fold scroll-set predictions to patient level
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

get_patient_level_preds <- function(mod, id_lookup, pos_class = "X1") {
  
  preds <- mod$pred
  
  # Keep only best tuning parameters if relevant
  if (!is.null(mod$bestTune) && nrow(mod$bestTune) > 0) {
    for (p in names(mod$bestTune)) {
      preds <- preds[preds[[p]] == mod$bestTune[[p]], , drop = FALSE]
    }
  }
  
  # Attach specimen and patient identifiers
  preds <- preds %>%
    left_join(
      id_lookup,
      by = "rowIndex"
    )
  
  # Check that all predictions mapped correctly
  if (any(is.na(preds$case_ID))) {
    stop("Some out-of-fold predictions did not map to case_ID. Check rowIndex alignment.")
  }
  
  # Aggregate scroll-set predictions to patient level within each resample.
  patient_preds <- preds %>%
    group_by(Resample, case_ID) %>%
    summarise(
      obs = first(endoscopy_outcome_binarized),
      n_scrollsets_in_resample = n(),
      patient_prob = max(.data[[pos_class]], na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  patient_preds
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 10.3 Apply aggregation to the continuous genomic model
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

patient_preds_cont <- get_patient_level_preds(
  mod = model_list[["Genomic (Continuous)"]],
  id_lookup = id_lookup_row,
  pos_class = "X1"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 10.4 Collapse repeated resample-level patient predictions to one probability
#      per patient for final ROC analysis
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

patient_preds_cont_final <- patient_preds_cont %>%
  group_by(case_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    obs = first(obs),
    patient_prob = mean(patient_prob, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_resamples = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

table(patient_preds_cont_final$obs)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 10.5 ROC analysis at patient level
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

roc_patient_cont <- pROC::roc(
  response = patient_preds_cont_final$obs,
  predictor = patient_preds_cont_final$patient_prob,
  levels = c("X0", "X1"),
  direction = "<",
  ci = TRUE,
  quiet = TRUE
)

patient_auc <- as.numeric(pROC::auc(roc_patient_cont))
patient_auc_ci <- as.numeric(pROC::ci.auc(roc_patient_cont, method = "delong"))

print(patient_auc)
print(patient_auc_ci)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 10.6 Derive optimal threshold using Youden's J
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

youden_patient_cont <- pROC::coords(
  roc_patient_cont,
  x = "best",
  best.method = "youden",
  ret = c("threshold", "sensitivity", "specificity"),
  transpose = FALSE
)

thr_patient_cont <- as.numeric(youden_patient_cont$threshold[1])

print(youden_patient_cont)
print(thr_patient_cont)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 10.7 Classify patient-level predictions and calculate performance metrics
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

patient_preds_cont_final <- patient_preds_cont_final %>%
  mutate(
    pred_class = ifelse(patient_prob > thr_patient_cont, "X1", "X0"),
    pred_class = factor(pred_class, levels = c("X0", "X1")),
    obs = factor(obs, levels = c("X0", "X1"))
  )

cm_patient_cont <- caret::confusionMatrix(
  data = patient_preds_cont_final$pred_class,
  reference = patient_preds_cont_final$obs,
  positive = "X1"
)

print(cm_patient_cont)

patient_level_summary <- tibble(
  Model = "Genomic continuous, patient-level aggregation",
  AUC = patient_auc,
  AUC_lower = patient_auc_ci[1],
  AUC_upper = patient_auc_ci[3],
  Threshold = thr_patient_cont,
  Accuracy = unname(cm_patient_cont$overall["Accuracy"]),
  Sensitivity = unname(cm_patient_cont$byClass["Sensitivity"]),
  Specificity = unname(cm_patient_cont$byClass["Specificity"]),
  PPV = unname(cm_patient_cont$byClass["Pos Pred Value"]),
  NPV = unname(cm_patient_cont$byClass["Neg Pred Value"])
)

print(patient_level_summary, n = Inf, width = Inf)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 11.4 Helper functions for coefficient tables
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

format_p_value <- function(p) {
  ifelse(
    p < 0.0001,
    "<0.0001",
    formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 4)
  )
}

interpret_coef <- function(beta, p) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    p < 0.05 & beta > 0   ~ "Positive association",
    p < 0.05 & beta < 0   ~ "Negative association",
    p >= 0.05 & p < 0.1 & beta > 0 ~ "Trend towards positive",
    p >= 0.05 & p < 0.1 & beta < 0 ~ "Trend towards negative",
    TRUE                  ~ "No clear association"
  )
}

recode_predictor_names <- function(x) {
  dplyr::recode(
    x,
    "(Intercept)" = "Intercept",
    "genome_wide_CNA_burden" = "GW-CNA burden (continuous)",
    "genome_wide_CNA_burden_binaryHigh burden" = "GW-CNA burden (High versus Low)",
    "chr2q" = "Chromosomal arm 2q",
    "chr3q" = "Chromosomal arm 3q",
    "chr9p" = "Chromosomal arm 9p",
    "chr11q" = "Chromosomal arm 11q",
    .default = x
  )
}

format_coef_table <- function(mod, desired_order) {
  
  summary(mod)$coefficients %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("Predictor_raw") %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      Coefficient = Estimate,
      Std_Error = `Std. Error`,
      p_value = `Pr(>|z|)`
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Predictor = recode_predictor_names(Predictor_raw),
      Interpretation = if_else(
        Predictor == "Intercept",
        "Baseline risk",
        interpret_coef(Coefficient, p_value)
      ),
      Coefficient_beta = round(Coefficient, 2),
      Std_Error_formatted = round(Std_Error, 2),
      p_value_formatted = format_p_value(p_value),
      Predictor = factor(Predictor, levels = desired_order)
    ) %>%
    arrange(Predictor) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Predictor,
      Coefficient_beta,
      Std_Error_formatted,
      p_value_formatted,
      Interpretation
    )
}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 11.5 Extended Data Table 2A: continuous GW-CNA burden model
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

order_cont <- c(
  "Intercept",
  "GW-CNA burden (continuous)",
  "Chromosomal arm 2q",
  "Chromosomal arm 3q",
  "Chromosomal arm 9p",
  "Chromosomal arm 11q"
)

extended_data_table_2A <- format_coef_table(
  mod = mod_cont,
  desired_order = order_cont
) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    `Coefficient beta` = Coefficient_beta,
    `Std. error` = Std_Error_formatted,
    `P value` = p_value_formatted
  )

print(extended_data_table_2A)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 11.6 Extended Data Table 2B: binary GW-CNA burden model
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

order_bin <- c(
  "Intercept",
  "GW-CNA burden (High versus Low)",
  "Chromosomal arm 2q",
  "Chromosomal arm 3q",
  "Chromosomal arm 9p",
  "Chromosomal arm 11q"
)

extended_data_table_2B <- format_coef_table(
  mod = mod_bin,
  desired_order = order_bin
)

print(extended_data_table_2B)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 11.8 Save tables
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

readr::write_tsv(
  extended_data_table_2A,
  file.path(tables_dir, "Extended_Data_Table_2A_continuous_genomic_coefficients.tsv")
)

readr::write_csv(
  extended_data_table_2A,
  file.path(tables_dir, "Extended_Data_Table_2A_continuous_genomic_coefficients.csv")
)

readr::write_tsv(
  extended_data_table_2B,
  file.path(tables_dir, "Extended_Data_Table_2B_binary_genomic_coefficients.tsv")
)

readr::write_csv(

)


# ==============================================================================
# 12. Genome-wide 50 kb bin-level copy-number dispersion by diagnostic group
# ==============================================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)
library(readr)
library(rstatix)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 12.1 Diagnostic group labels
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

diagnostic_levels <- c(
  "normal",
  "benign_conditions",
  "IEN_early_cancer"
)

diagnostic_labels <- c(
  "Normal",
  "Benign",
  "IEN/early cancer"
)

standardise_outcome_tri <- function(x) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    as.character(x) %in% c("normal", "Normal") ~ "Normal",
    as.character(x) %in% c("benign_conditions", "Benign") ~ "Benign",
    as.character(x) %in% c("IEN_early_cancer", "IEN/early cancer") ~ "IEN/early cancer",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 12.2 Build annotated 50 kb copy-number dataframe if not already available
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (!exists("sponge_CN_50kb_long_annot")) {
  
  sponge_CN_50kb_long_annot <- sponge_CN_50kb_long %>%
    inner_join(
      clinical_df,
      by = "sequencing_ID"
    ) %>%
    inner_join(
      gw_burden_df %>%
        dplyr::select(
          specimen_ID,
          genome_wide_CNA_burden,
          genome_wide_CNA_burden_binary,
          outcome_tri_category
        ),
      by = "specimen_ID"
    )
}

sponge_CN_50kb_long_annot <- sponge_CN_50kb_long_annot %>%
  mutate(
    chromosome_num = as.integer(gsub("^chr", "", as.character(chromosome))),
    outcome_tri_category = standardise_outcome_tri(outcome_tri_category),
    outcome_tri_category = factor(
      outcome_tri_category,
      levels = diagnostic_labels
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    chromosome_num %in% 1:22
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 12.3 Calculate 50 kb bin-level copy-number dispersion per scroll-set
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

dispersion_50kb_bins <- sponge_CN_50kb_long_annot %>%
  group_by(
    sequencing_ID,
    specimen_ID,
    case_ID,
    outcome_tri_category
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n_bins = n(),
    dispersion_50kb_bin_sd = sd(segmented_CN, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_50kb_CN = median(segmented_CN, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_50kb_CN = mean(segmented_CN, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Basic checks
cat("\n--- Scroll-set counts by diagnostic group ---\n")
print(table(dispersion_50kb_bins$outcome_tri_category, useNA = "ifany"))

cat("\n--- Number of scroll-sets ---\n")
print(nrow(dispersion_50kb_bins))

cat("\n--- Number of bins per scroll-set ---\n")
dispersion_50kb_bins %>%
  count(n_bins) %>%
  arrange(n_bins) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 12.4 Group-level summary 
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

summary_50kb_bins <- dispersion_50kb_bins %>%
  group_by(outcome_tri_category) %>%
  summarise(
    n_scrollsets = n(),
    n_patients = n_distinct(case_ID),
    median_sd = median(dispersion_50kb_bin_sd, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_sd = mean(dispersion_50kb_bin_sd, na.rm = TRUE),
    q1_sd = quantile(dispersion_50kb_bin_sd, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q3_sd = quantile(dispersion_50kb_bin_sd, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_sd = min(dispersion_50kb_bin_sd, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_sd = max(dispersion_50kb_bin_sd, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(summary_50kb_bins, n = Inf)

summary_50kb_bins_for_text <- summary_50kb_bins %>%
  mutate(
    median_sd_text = sprintf("%.4f", median_sd),
    q1_q3_text = sprintf("%.4f–%.4f", q1_sd, q3_sd)
  )

print(summary_50kb_bins_for_text, n = Inf)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 12.5 Kruskal-Wallis test across diagnostic groups
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

kw_50kb_sd <- kruskal.test(
  dispersion_50kb_bin_sd ~ outcome_tri_category,
  data = dispersion_50kb_bins
)

kw_50kb_sd_tbl <- tibble(
  test = "Kruskal-Wallis",
  variable = "dispersion_50kb_bin_sd",
  statistic = unname(kw_50kb_sd$statistic),
  df = unname(kw_50kb_sd$parameter),
  p_value = kw_50kb_sd$p.value,
  p_adj_BH = p.adjust(kw_50kb_sd$p.value, method = "BH")
)

print(kw_50kb_sd_tbl)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 12.6 Post-hoc Dunn tests with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR adjustment
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

dunn_50kb_sd <- rstatix::dunn_test(
  data = dispersion_50kb_bins,
  formula = dispersion_50kb_bin_sd ~ outcome_tri_category,
  p.adjust.method = "BH"
) %>%
  mutate(
    p = as.numeric(p),
    p.adj = as.numeric(p.adj)
  )

print(dunn_50kb_sd, n = Inf)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 12.7 Formatted p-values
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

format_p_for_text <- function(p) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(p) ~ NA_character_,
    p < 0.001 ~ formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 2),
    TRUE ~ formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 4)
  )
}

kw_50kb_sd_for_text <- kw_50kb_sd_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    p_value_text = format_p_for_text(p_value),
    p_adj_BH_text = format_p_for_text(p_adj_BH)
  )

dunn_50kb_sd_for_text <- dunn_50kb_sd %>%
  mutate(
    p_text = format_p_for_text(p),
    p_adj_text = format_p_for_text(p.adj)
  ) %>%
  select(
    group1,
    group2,
    statistic,
    p,
    p.adj,
    p_text,
    p_adj_text
  )

cat("\n--- Summary values ---\n")
print(summary_50kb_bins_for_text, n = Inf, width = Inf)

cat("\n--- Kruskal-Wallis formatted for text ---\n")
print(kw_50kb_sd_for_text)

cat("\n--- Dunn tests formatted for text ---\n")
print(dunn_50kb_sd_for_text, n = Inf)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 11.12 Save output tables
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

readr::write_tsv(
  dispersion_50kb_bins,
  file.path(tables_dir, "scrollset_level_50kb_copy_number_dispersion.tsv")
)

readr::write_csv(
  dispersion_50kb_bins,
  file.path(tables_dir, "scrollset_level_50kb_copy_number_dispersion.csv")
)

readr::write_tsv(
  summary_50kb_bins,
  file.path(tables_dir, "summary_50kb_copy_number_dispersion_by_diagnostic_group.tsv")
)

readr::write_csv(
  summary_50kb_bins,
  file.path(tables_dir, "summary_50kb_copy_number_dispersion_by_diagnostic_group.csv")
)

readr::write_tsv(
  kw_50kb_sd_tbl,
  file.path(tables_dir, "kruskal_wallis_50kb_copy_number_dispersion.tsv")
)

readr::write_csv(
  kw_50kb_sd_tbl,
  file.path(tables_dir, "kruskal_wallis_50kb_copy_number_dispersion.csv")
)

readr::write_tsv(
  dunn_50kb_sd,
  file.path(tables_dir, "dunn_tests_50kb_copy_number_dispersion_BH.tsv")
)

)


# ==============================================================================
# 13. Microdissected ESD tissue analysis
#     Figure 5B and Figure 5C
#
#     Progression series: ST-NC → ANSE → LG-IEN → HG-IEN → OSCC
#
#     Figure 5B:
#       Radar plot of key-arm alteration prevalence across pathology states
#
#     Figure 5C:
#       Genome-wide CNA burden across pathology states
# ==============================================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(rstatix)
library(ggsignif)
library(fmsb)
library(scales)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 13.1 Load and tidy ESD data
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Use esd_data if already loaded earlier.
# Otherwise, read from data_dir.
if (!exists("esd_data")) {
  esd_data <- readr::read_tsv(
    file.path(data_dir, "esd_segments.tsv"),
    col_types = cols()
  )
}


esd_data_13 <- esd_data %>%
  mutate(
    Specimen_pathology = dplyr::recode(
      as.character(Specimen_pathology),
      "Reference" = "ST-NC",
      "Normal_epithelium" = "ANSE",
      "LGD" = "LG-IEN",
      "HGD" = "HG-IEN",
      "OSCC" = "OSCC",
      "ST-NC" = "ST-NC",
      "ANSE" = "ANSE",
      "LG-IEN" = "LG-IEN",
      "HG-IEN" = "HG-IEN",
      .default = as.character(Specimen_pathology)
    ),
    Specimen_pathology = factor(
      Specimen_pathology,
      levels = c("ST-NC", "ANSE", "LG-IEN", "HG-IEN", "OSCC")
    )
  )

cat("\n--- ESD pathology counts ---\n")
print(table(esd_data_13$Specimen_pathology, useNA = "ifany"))

if (any(is.na(esd_data_13$Specimen_pathology))) {
  stop("Some ESD pathology labels did not map correctly. Check unique(esd_data$Specimen_pathology).")
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 13.2 Call altered 50 kb bins using arm-wise ST-NC robust control bounds
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

esd_control_bounds <- esd_data_13 %>%
  filter(Specimen_pathology == "ST-NC") %>%
  group_by(chromosomal_arm) %>%
  summarise(
    med = median(segmented_CN, na.rm = TRUE),
    iqr = IQR(segmented_CN, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    lower = med - 1.5 * iqr,
    upper = med + 1.5 * iqr
  )

esd_altered <- esd_data_13 %>%
  left_join(esd_control_bounds, by = "chromosomal_arm") %>%
  mutate(
    is_altered = if_else(
      segmented_CN < lower | segmented_CN > upper,
      1L,
      0L
    )
  )

cat("\n--- ESD altered-bin summary ---\n")
print(
  esd_altered %>%
    summarise(
      n_bins = n(),
      n_altered = sum(is_altered, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_altered = 100 * mean(is_altered, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 13.3 Genome-wide CNA burden per microdissected region
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

esd_burden <- esd_altered %>%
  group_by(SpecimenID, Specimen_pathology) %>%
  summarise(
    altered = sum(is_altered, na.rm = TRUE),
    total = n(),
    gw_cna_burden = altered / total,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Specimen_pathology = factor(
      Specimen_pathology,
      levels = c("ST-NC", "ANSE", "LG-IEN", "HG-IEN", "OSCC")
    )
  )

# Threshold = 95th percentile of ST-NC burden
esd_gw_thr <- esd_burden %>%
  filter(Specimen_pathology == "ST-NC") %>%
  summarise(
    threshold = quantile(gw_cna_burden, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  pull(threshold)

esd_burden <- esd_burden %>%
  mutate(
    unstable = gw_cna_burden >= esd_gw_thr
  )

cat("\n--- ESD GW-CNA burden threshold ---\n")
cat("95th percentile of ST-NC =", sprintf("%.6f", esd_gw_thr), "\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 13.4 Summary statistics 
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

esd_burden_summary <- esd_burden %>%
  group_by(Specimen_pathology) %>%
  summarise(
    n_regions = n(),
    median_burden = median(gw_cna_burden, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_burden = mean(gw_cna_burden, na.rm = TRUE),
    q1_burden = quantile(gw_cna_burden, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q3_burden = quantile(gw_cna_burden, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    iqr_burden = IQR(gw_cna_burden, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_burden = min(gw_cna_burden, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_burden = max(gw_cna_burden, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_unstable = sum(unstable, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_unstable = 100 * mean(unstable, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    median_iqr_text = sprintf("%.3f [%.3f]", median_burden, iqr_burden),
    q1_q3_text = sprintf("%.3f–%.3f", q1_burden, q3_burden),
    unstable_text = sprintf("%d/%d (%.1f%%)", n_unstable, n_regions, pct_unstable)
  )

cat("\n--- ESD GW-CNA burden summary by pathology ---\n")
print(esd_burden_summary, n = Inf)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 13.5 Statistical comparison across pathology stages
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

kw_esd <- rstatix::kruskal_test(
  gw_cna_burden ~ Specimen_pathology,
  data = esd_burden
)

dunn_esd <- rstatix::dunn_test(
  gw_cna_burden ~ Specimen_pathology,
  data = esd_burden,
  p.adjust.method = "hochberg"
)

cat("\n--- ESD GW-CNA burden Kruskal-Wallis test ---\n")
print(kw_esd)

cat("\n--- ESD GW-CNA burden Dunn post-hoc tests ---\n")
print(dunn_esd, n = Inf)

# Keep only selected OSCC comparisons for plot brackets
esd_pairs_keep <- tibble::tribble(
  ~group1, ~group2,
  "ST-NC", "OSCC",
  "ANSE",  "OSCC"
)

dunn_keep_esd <- dunn_esd %>%
  semi_join(esd_pairs_keep, by = c("group1", "group2")) %>%
  arrange(match(group1, levels(esd_burden$Specimen_pathology))) %>%
  mutate(
    p_label = p.adj.signif
  )

comparisons_esd <- dunn_keep_esd %>%
  transmute(comp = Map(c, group1, group2)) %>%
  pull(comp)

y_max_esd <- max(esd_burden$gw_cna_burden, na.rm = TRUE)

dunn_keep_esd <- dunn_keep_esd %>%
  mutate(
    ypos = y_max_esd + seq(0.08, 0.12, length.out = n())
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 13.6 Colour palette for ESD pathology states
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cols_pathology <- c(
  "ST-NC"  = "#ff7f0e",
  "ANSE"   = "#9467bd",
  "LG-IEN" = "#2ca02c",
  "HG-IEN" = "#1f77b4",
  "OSCC"   = "#d62728"
)

x_levels_esd <- c("ST-NC", "ANSE", "LG-IEN", "HG-IEN", "OSCC")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 13.7 Figure 5C: ESD genome-wide CNA burden boxplot
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

p_esd_burden <- ggplot(
  esd_burden,
  aes(
    x = Specimen_pathology,
    y = gw_cna_burden,
    fill = Specimen_pathology
  )
) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    limits = x_levels_esd,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.5,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    linewidth = 0.6,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = cols_pathology,
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  ggsignif::geom_signif(
    comparisons = comparisons_esd,
    annotations = dunn_keep_esd$p_label,
    y_position = dunn_keep_esd$ypos,
    tip_length = 0.01,
    vjust = 0.4,
    textsize = 4,
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = c(0, max(dunn_keep_esd$ypos, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.06),
    clip = "off"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Sample pathology",
    y = "Genome-wide CNA burden"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey88", linewidth = 0.45),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

print(p_esd_burden)

ggsave(
  file.path(fig_dir, "Figure_5C.pdf"),
  p_esd_burden,
  width = 6.4,
  height = 5.6,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 600,
  device = cairo_pdf
)

ggsave(
  file.path(fig_dir, "Figure_5C.png"),
  p_esd_burden,
  width = 6.4,
  height = 5.6,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 13.8 Figure 5B: Radar plot of key-arm alteration prevalence
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

key_arms_esd <- c("chr2q", "chr3q", "chr9p", "chr11q")

per_sample_arm_esd <- esd_altered %>%
  filter(chromosomal_arm %in% key_arms_esd) %>%
  group_by(SpecimenID, Specimen_pathology, chromosomal_arm) %>%
  summarise(
    prop_altered = mean(is_altered, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

mean_per_pathology_esd <- per_sample_arm_esd %>%
  group_by(Specimen_pathology, chromosomal_arm) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_prop = mean(prop_altered, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

spoke_order_esd <- c("chr11q", "chr9p", "chr3q", "chr2q")

mean_per_pathology_esd <- mean_per_pathology_esd %>%
  mutate(
    chromosomal_arm = factor(
      chromosomal_arm,
      levels = spoke_order_esd
    )
  )

radar_mat_esd <- mean_per_pathology_esd %>%
  arrange(chromosomal_arm) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = chromosomal_arm,
    values_from = mean_prop
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(spoke_order_esd),
      ~ 100 * .x
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    factor(
      Specimen_pathology,
      levels = x_levels_esd
    )
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Specimen_pathology") %>%
  as.data.frame()

radar_mat_esd[is.na(radar_mat_esd)] <- 0

radar_bounds_esd <- rbind(
  max = setNames(rep(100, ncol(radar_mat_esd)), colnames(radar_mat_esd)),
  min = setNames(rep(0,   ncol(radar_mat_esd)), colnames(radar_mat_esd))
)

radar_df_esd <- rbind(
  radar_bounds_esd,
  radar_mat_esd
)

group_levels_esd <- rownames(radar_mat_esd)
line_cols_esd <- cols_pathology[group_levels_esd]
fill_cols_esd <- scales::alpha(line_cols_esd, 0.18)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Export Figure 5B as PDF and PNG
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

plot_esd_radar <- function() {
  
  op <- par(mar = c(1, 2, 2, 2), xpd = NA)
  on.exit(par(op))
  
  fmsb::radarchart(
    radar_df_esd,
    axistype = 1,
    seg = 4,
    caxislabels = c("0%", "25%", "50%", "75%", "100%"),
    cglcol = "grey85",
    cglty = 1,
    cglwd = 0.8,
    vlabels = colnames(radar_df_esd),
    vlcex = 1.0,
    pcol = line_cols_esd,
    pfcol = fill_cols_esd,
    plwd = 2.2,
    plty = 1
  )
  
  legend(
    "bottom",
    legend = group_levels_esd,
    horiz = TRUE,
    bty = "n",
    col = line_cols_esd,
    lwd = 3,
    pt.cex = 1.8,
    cex = 0.95,
    xpd = NA,
    inset = -0.02
  )
}

# PDF export
pdf(
  file.path(fig_dir, "Figure_5B.pdf"),
  width = 6.2,
  height = 7,
  useDingbats = FALSE
)

plot_esd_radar()

dev.off()

png(
  file.path(fig_dir, "Figure_5B.png"),
  width = 6.2,
  height = 7,
  units = "in",
  res = 600,
  type = "cairo",
  bg = "white"
)

plot_esd_radar()

cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("Final ESD tissue results\n")
cat("============================================================\n\n")

cat("--- ESD GW-CNA burden summary by pathology ---\n")
print(esd_burden_summary, n = Inf, width = Inf)

cat("\n--- ESD GW-CNA burden threshold ---\n")
cat("95th percentile of ST-NC =", sprintf("%.6f", esd_gw_thr), "\n")

cat("\n--- ESD Kruskal-Wallis test ---\n")
print(kw_esd)

cat("\n--- ESD Dunn post-hoc tests ---\n")
print(dunn_esd, n = Inf)

cat("\n--- ESD key-arm mean alteration prevalence for radar plot ---\n")
print(mean_per_pathology_esd, n = Inf)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 13.11 Binary key-arm alteration prevalence 
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

key_arms_esd <- c("chr2q", "chr3q", "chr9p", "chr11q")

# Calculate arm-level alteration density per ESD region
esd_arm_level_density <- esd_altered %>%
  filter(chromosomal_arm %in% key_arms_esd) %>%
  group_by(SpecimenID, Specimen_pathology, chromosomal_arm) %>%
  summarise(
    altered_segments = sum(is_altered, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_segments = n(),
    alteration_density = altered_segments / total_segments,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 95th percentile of Reference/ST-NC density across the four key arms
esd_key_arm_density <- esd_altered %>%
  filter(chromosomal_arm %in% key_arms_esd) %>%
  group_by(SpecimenID, Specimen_pathology) %>%
  summarise(
    altered_segments = sum(is_altered, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_segments = n(),
    key_arm_density = altered_segments / total_segments,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

esd_key_arm_threshold <- quantile(
  esd_key_arm_density %>%
    filter(Specimen_pathology == "ST-NC") %>%
    pull(key_arm_density),
  probs = 0.95,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

cat("\n--- ESD key-arm alteration threshold ---\n")
cat("95th percentile of ST-NC key-arm density =", sprintf("%.6f", esd_key_arm_threshold), "\n")

# Classify each sample-arm as altered/not altered
esd_alteration_status <- esd_arm_level_density %>%
  mutate(
    is_arm_altered = if_else(
      alteration_density >= esd_key_arm_threshold,
      1L,
      0L
    )
  )

# Summarise n/N prevalence by arm and pathology group
esd_arm_alteration_summary <- esd_alteration_status %>%
  group_by(chromosomal_arm, Specimen_pathology) %>%
  summarise(
    altered = sum(is_arm_altered, na.rm = TRUE),
    total = n_distinct(SpecimenID),
    frequency = 100 * altered / total,
    label = paste0(altered, "/", total, " (", round(frequency, 1), "%)"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    factor(chromosomal_arm, levels = key_arms_esd),
    Specimen_pathology
  )

cat("\n--- ESD binary key-arm alteration prevalence ---\n")
print(esd_arm_alteration_summary, n = Inf)

# Wider table 
esd_arm_alteration_summary_wide <- esd_arm_alteration_summary %>%
  select(chromosomal_arm, Specimen_pathology, label) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Specimen_pathology,
    values_from = label
  )

cat("\n--- ESD binary key-arm alteration prevalence, wide format ---\n")
print(esd_arm_alteration_summary_wide, n = Inf)

# At least one alteration in any of the four key arms
esd_any_key_arm_alteration <- esd_alteration_status %>%
  group_by(SpecimenID, Specimen_pathology) %>%
  summarise(
    has_any_key_arm_alteration = any(is_arm_altered == 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

esd_any_key_arm_summary <- esd_any_key_arm_alteration %>%
  group_by(Specimen_pathology) %>%
  summarise(
    samples_with_alteration = sum(has_any_key_arm_alteration, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_samples = n_distinct(SpecimenID),
    percent_with_alteration = 100 * samples_with_alteration / total_samples,
    label = paste0(
      samples_with_alteration,
      "/",
      total_samples,
      " (",
      round(percent_with_alteration, 1),
      "%)"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("\n--- ESD samples with at least one key-arm alteration ---\n")
print(esd_any_key_arm_summary, n = Inf)

# Optional: list altered arms per sample
esd_altered_arms_per_sample <- esd_alteration_status %>%
  filter(is_arm_altered == 1) %>%
  group_by(SpecimenID, Specimen_pathology) %>%
  summarise(
    altered_arms = paste(sort(unique(chromosomal_arm)), collapse = ", "),
    n_altered_arms = n_distinct(chromosomal_arm),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

esd_all_key_arm_samples <- esd_alteration_status %>%
  distinct(SpecimenID, Specimen_pathology)

esd_altered_arms_summary <- esd_all_key_arm_samples %>%
  left_join(
    esd_altered_arms_per_sample,
    by = c("SpecimenID", "Specimen_pathology")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    altered_arms = if_else(is.na(altered_arms), "None", altered_arms),
    n_altered_arms = if_else(is.na(n_altered_arms), 0L, n_altered_arms)
  )

cat("\n--- ESD altered arms per sample ---\n")
print(esd_altered_arms_summary, n = Inf)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 13.12 Ordered trend tests for binary key-arm alteration prevalence
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

pathology_levels_esd <- c("ST-NC", "ANSE", "LG-IEN", "HG-IEN", "OSCC")
pathology_scores_esd <- seq_along(pathology_levels_esd)

format_p_for_text <- function(p) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(p) ~ NA_character_,
    p < 0.001 ~ formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 2),
    TRUE ~ formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 4)
  )
}

run_ordered_trend_test <- function(df, binary_col, feature_name) {
  
  test_df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      Specimen_pathology = factor(
        Specimen_pathology,
        levels = pathology_levels_esd
      ),
      binary_value = as.integer(.data[[binary_col]])
    )
  
  counts_df <- test_df %>%
    group_by(Specimen_pathology) %>%
    summarise(
      altered = sum(binary_value == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      total = n_distinct(SpecimenID),
      frequency = 100 * altered / total,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(Specimen_pathology)
  
  trend_res <- prop.trend.test(
    x = counts_df$altered,
    n = counts_df$total,
    score = pathology_scores_esd
  )
  
  tibble::tibble(
    feature = feature_name,
    test = "Cochran-Armitage ordered trend test",
    statistic = unname(trend_res$statistic),
    df = unname(trend_res$parameter),
    p_value = trend_res$p.value
  )
}

# Trend tests for each individual key arm
esd_key_arm_trend_tests <- purrr::map_dfr(
  key_arms_esd,
  function(arm_now) {
    run_ordered_trend_test(
      df = esd_alteration_status %>%
        filter(chromosomal_arm == arm_now),
      binary_col = "is_arm_altered",
      feature_name = arm_now
    )
  }
)

# Trend test for alteration in at least one of the four key arms
esd_any_key_arm_trend_test <- run_ordered_trend_test(
  df = esd_any_key_arm_alteration,
  binary_col = "has_any_key_arm_alteration",
  feature_name = "Any key arm"
)

# Combine and adjust across the five reported trend tests
esd_trend_tests_for_text <- bind_rows(
  esd_key_arm_trend_tests,
  esd_any_key_arm_trend_test
) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj_hochberg = p.adjust(p_value, method = "hochberg"),
    p_adj_BH = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
    p_value_text = format_p_for_text(p_value),
    p_adj_hochberg_text = format_p_for_text(p_adj_hochberg),
    p_adj_BH_text = format_p_for_text(p_adj_BH)
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    factor(feature, levels = c("chr2q", "chr3q", "chr9p", "chr11q", "Any key arm"))
  )

cat("\n--- ESD ordered trend tests for binary key-arm alteration prevalence ---\n")
print(esd_trend_tests_for_text, n = Inf)

# Save trend-test results 
readr::write_tsv(
  esd_trend_tests_for_text,
  file.path(tables_dir, "Figure_5B_ESD_binary_key_arm_ordered_trend_tests.tsv")
)

readr::write_csv(
  esd_trend_tests_for_text,
  file.path(tables_dir, "Figure_5B_ESD_binary_key_arm_ordered_trend_tests.csv")
)
```
