```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# 14. Sensitivity analysis: repeated scroll-sets and patient-level performance
# ==============================================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(purrr)
library(geepack)
library(pROC)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create complete-case dataframe for GEE analysis
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# This keeps case_ID for participant-level clustering.
# It does not overwrite the original model_df_cc used for the original caret models.

gee_required_vars <- unique(c(
  "case_ID",
  target,
  copy_number_continuous,
  copy_number_binary,
  pathology_vars
))

missing_gee_vars <- setdiff(gee_required_vars, names(model_df))
if (length(missing_gee_vars) > 0) {
  stop(
    "The following variables are missing from model_df for the GEE sensitivity analysis: ",
    paste(missing_gee_vars, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

model_df_cc_gee <- model_df %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(gee_required_vars)) %>%
  tidyr::drop_na()

cat("\n--- GEE complete-case dataframe columns ---\n")
print(names(model_df_cc_gee))

cat("\n--- GEE complete-case outcome counts ---\n")
print(table(model_df_cc_gee$endoscopy_outcome_binarized))

cat("\n--- GEE complete-case participant/scroll-set counts ---\n")
print(
  model_df_cc_gee %>%
    summarise(
      n_scrollsets = n(),
      n_patients = n_distinct(case_ID),
      n_non_IEN_early_cancer_scrollsets = sum(endoscopy_outcome_binarized == "X0"),
      n_IEN_early_cancer_scrollsets = sum(endoscopy_outcome_binarized == "X1"),
      n_non_IEN_early_cancer_patients = n_distinct(case_ID[endoscopy_outcome_binarized == "X0"]),
      n_IEN_early_cancer_patients = n_distinct(case_ID[endoscopy_outcome_binarized == "X1"])
    )
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Prepare  GEE dataframe
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

gee_df_raw <- model_df_cc_gee %>%
  mutate(
    outcome_gee = case_when(
      endoscopy_outcome_binarized == "X1" ~ 1,
      endoscopy_outcome_binarized == "X0" ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    cluster_id = as.integer(factor(case_ID)),
    
    genome_wide_CNA_burden_binary = factor(
      as.character(genome_wide_CNA_burden_binary),
      levels = c("Low burden", "High burden")
    ),
    
    cytosponge_definite_sq_atypia = factor(
      as.character(cytosponge_definite_sq_atypia),
      levels = c("0", "1")
    ),
    
    p53_staining_binarized = factor(
      as.character(p53_staining_binarized),
      levels = c("0", "1")
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(outcome_gee)) %>%
  arrange(cluster_id)

cat("\n--- Raw GEE cluster check ---\n")

gee_cluster_check_raw <- gee_df_raw %>%
  summarise(
    n_scrollsets = n(),
    n_patients = n_distinct(case_ID),
    n_clusters = n_distinct(cluster_id),
    max_scrollsets_per_patient = max(as.numeric(table(case_ID))),
    n_X0_scrollsets = sum(outcome_gee == 0),
    n_X1_scrollsets = sum(outcome_gee == 1),
    n_X0_patients = n_distinct(case_ID[outcome_gee == 0]),
    n_X1_patients = n_distinct(case_ID[outcome_gee == 1])
  )

print(gee_cluster_check_raw)

stopifnot(gee_cluster_check_raw$n_clusters == gee_cluster_check_raw$n_patients)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Define  model features
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

gee_model_features_raw <- list(
  "Continuous genomic model" = c(
    "genome_wide_CNA_burden",
    "chr2q",
    "chr3q",
    "chr9p",
    "chr11q"
  ),
  
  "Binary genomic model" = c(
    "genome_wide_CNA_burden_binary",
    "chr2q",
    "chr3q",
    "chr9p",
    "chr11q"
  ),
  
  "Pathology model" = c(
    "cytosponge_definite_sq_atypia",
    "p53_staining_binarized"
  )
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper functions for  GEE
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

make_gee_formula_raw <- function(features) {
  as.formula(
    paste("outcome_gee ~", paste(features, collapse = " + "))
  )
}

fit_gee_model_raw <- function(df, features) {
  geepack::geeglm(
    formula = make_gee_formula_raw(features),
    id = cluster_id,
    data = df,
    family = binomial(link = "logit"),
    corstr = "independence",
    control = geepack::geese.control(maxit = 100)
  )
}

calculate_diagnostic_metrics_raw <- function(df, truth_col = "outcome_gee", pred_col = "pred_prob") {
  
  roc_obj <- pROC::roc(
    response = df[[truth_col]],
    predictor = df[[pred_col]],
    levels = c(0, 1),
    direction = "<",
    quiet = TRUE
  )
  
  auc_value <- as.numeric(pROC::auc(roc_obj))
  
  best_coords <- pROC::coords(
    roc_obj,
    x = "best",
    best.method = "youden",
    ret = c("threshold", "sensitivity", "specificity"),
    transpose = FALSE
  )
  
  best_coords <- as.data.frame(best_coords)
  threshold <- as.numeric(best_coords$threshold[1])
  
  df_classified <- df %>%
    mutate(
      pred_class = if_else(.data[[pred_col]] >= threshold, 1, 0)
    )
  
  tp <- sum(df_classified$pred_class == 1 & df_classified[[truth_col]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  tn <- sum(df_classified$pred_class == 0 & df_classified[[truth_col]] == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  fp <- sum(df_classified$pred_class == 1 & df_classified[[truth_col]] == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  fn <- sum(df_classified$pred_class == 0 & df_classified[[truth_col]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  tibble(
    auc = auc_value,
    threshold = threshold,
    sensitivity = tp / (tp + fn),
    specificity = tn / (tn + fp),
    accuracy = (tp + tn) / (tp + tn + fp + fn),
    ppv = tp / (tp + fp),
    npv = tn / (tn + fn),
    tp = tp,
    tn = tn,
    fp = fp,
    fn = fn
  )
}

run_gee_model_raw <- function(df, features, model_name) {
  
  gee_fit <- fit_gee_model_raw(df, features)
  
  n_clusters_used <- length(gee_fit$geese$clusz)
  
  if (n_clusters_used != n_distinct(df$cluster_id)) {
    stop(
      "Raw/unscaled GEE clustering failed for ", model_name,
      ". Expected ", n_distinct(df$cluster_id),
      " clusters but got ", n_clusters_used, "."
    )
  }
  
  df_pred <- df %>%
    mutate(
      pred_prob = as.numeric(predict(gee_fit, type = "response"))
    )
  
  scrollset_metrics <- calculate_diagnostic_metrics_raw(df_pred) %>%
    mutate(
      model = model_name,
      analysis_level = "Scroll-set-level GEE prediction",
      scaling = "Unscaled"
    )
  
  patient_pred <- df_pred %>%
    group_by(case_ID) %>%
    summarise(
      outcome_gee = first(outcome_gee),
      pred_prob = mean(pred_prob, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_scrollsets = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  patient_metrics <- calculate_diagnostic_metrics_raw(patient_pred) %>%
    mutate(
      model = model_name,
      analysis_level = "Patient-level averaged GEE prediction",
      scaling = "Unscaled"
    )
  
  list(
    fit = gee_fit,
    scrollset_predictions = df_pred,
    patient_predictions = patient_pred,
    metrics = bind_rows(scrollset_metrics, patient_metrics)
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Run  GEE models
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

gee_results_raw <- purrr::imap(
  gee_model_features_raw,
  ~ run_gee_model_raw(
    df = gee_df_raw,
    features = .x,
    model_name = .y
  )
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Raw diagnostic performance table
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

gee_performance_table_raw <- purrr::map_dfr(
  gee_results_raw,
  ~ .x$metrics
) %>%
  select(
    scaling,
    model,
    analysis_level,
    auc,
    sensitivity,
    specificity,
    accuracy,
    ppv,
    npv,
    threshold,
    tp,
    tn,
    fp,
    fn
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(auc, sensitivity, specificity, accuracy, ppv, npv, threshold),
      ~ round(.x, 3)
    )
  )

cat("\n--- Raw/unscaled GEE diagnostic performance table ---\n")
print(gee_performance_table_raw, n = Inf)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Print GEE model summaries
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat("\n---  GEE model summaries ---\n")

for (model_name in names(gee_results_raw)) {
  cat("\n\n============================================================\n")
  cat(model_name, "\n")
  cat("============================================================\n")
  print(summary(gee_results_raw[[model_name]]$fit))
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Save outputs
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

write.csv(
  gee_performance_table_raw,
  file = file.path(
    gee_output_dir,
    "GEE_patient_level_diagnostic_performance.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

if (exists("gee_scaling_comparison_table")) {
  write.csv(
    gee_scaling_comparison_table,
    file = file.path(
      gee_output_dir,
      "GEE_standardised_vs_unscaled_comparison.csv"
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}

cat("\n---GEE outputs saved to: ", gee_output_dir, " ---\n")
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(purrr)
library(pROC)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Define variables needed for the final selected models
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

repro_required_vars <- c(
  "case_ID",
  "endoscopy_outcome_binarized",
  "chr9p",
  "chr2q",
  "chr3q",
  "chr11q",
  "genome_wide_CNA_burden",
  "genome_wide_CNA_burden_binary",
  "cytosponge_definite_sq_atypia",
  "p53_staining_binarized"
)

missing_repro_vars <- setdiff(repro_required_vars, names(model_df))

if (length(missing_repro_vars) > 0) {
  stop(
    "The following variables are missing from model_df: ",
    paste(missing_repro_vars, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Prepare complete-case dataframe
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

repro_df <- model_df %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(repro_required_vars)) %>%
  tidyr::drop_na() %>%
  mutate(
    outcome_binary = case_when(
      endoscopy_outcome_binarized == "X1" ~ 1,
      endoscopy_outcome_binarized == "X0" ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    genome_wide_CNA_burden_binary = factor(
      as.character(genome_wide_CNA_burden_binary),
      levels = c("Low burden", "High burden")
    ),
    cytosponge_definite_sq_atypia = factor(
      as.character(cytosponge_definite_sq_atypia),
      levels = c("0", "1")
    ),
    p53_staining_binarized = factor(
      as.character(p53_staining_binarized),
      levels = c("0", "1")
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(outcome_binary))

cat("\n--- Complete-case reproducibility dataset ---\n")
print(
  repro_df %>%
    summarise(
      n_scrollsets = n(),
      n_patients = n_distinct(case_ID)
    )
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Keep only participants with multiple scroll-sets
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

multi_scroll_cases <- repro_df %>%
  count(case_ID, name = "n_scrollsets") %>%
  filter(n_scrollsets > 1) %>%
  pull(case_ID)

repro_multi_df <- repro_df %>%
  filter(case_ID %in% multi_scroll_cases)

cat("\n--- Multi-scroll-set subset ---\n")
print(
  repro_multi_df %>%
    summarise(
      n_participants_with_multiple_scrollsets = n_distinct(case_ID),
      n_scrollsets_from_multi_scrollset_participants = n()
    )
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Define final selected models
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

repro_model_features <- list(
  "Continuous genomic model" = c(
    "genome_wide_CNA_burden",
    "chr2q",
    "chr3q",
    "chr9p",
    "chr11q"
  ),
  
  "Binary genomic model" = c(
    "genome_wide_CNA_burden_binary",
    "chr2q",
    "chr3q",
    "chr9p",
    "chr11q"
  ),
  
  "Pathology model" = c(
    "cytosponge_definite_sq_atypia",
    "p53_staining_binarized"
  )
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Helper functions
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

make_repro_formula <- function(features) {
  as.formula(
    paste("outcome_binary ~", paste(features, collapse = " + "))
  )
}

get_youden_threshold <- function(truth, pred_prob) {
  
  roc_obj <- pROC::roc(
    response = truth,
    predictor = pred_prob,
    levels = c(0, 1),
    direction = "<",
    quiet = TRUE
  )
  
  threshold <- pROC::coords(
    roc_obj,
    x = "best",
    best.method = "youden",
    ret = "threshold",
    transpose = FALSE
  )
  
  as.numeric(as.data.frame(threshold)$threshold[1])
}

run_simple_concordance <- function(df_all, df_multi, features, model_name) {
  
  # Fit the final model using the complete-case analysis dataset
  model_fit <- glm(
    formula = make_repro_formula(features),
    data = df_all,
    family = binomial(link = "logit")
  )
  
  # Use fitted probabilities from the complete-case dataset to define threshold
  df_all_pred <- df_all %>%
    mutate(
      pred_prob = as.numeric(
        predict(model_fit, newdata = df_all, type = "response")
      )
    )
  
  threshold <- get_youden_threshold(
    truth = df_all_pred$outcome_binary,
    pred_prob = df_all_pred$pred_prob
  )
  
  # Apply the same model and threshold to participants with multiple scroll-sets
  df_multi_pred <- df_multi %>%
    mutate(
      pred_prob = as.numeric(
        predict(model_fit, newdata = df_multi, type = "response")
      ),
      pred_class = if_else(pred_prob >= threshold, 1L, 0L)
    )
  
  # Complete concordance:
  # all scroll-sets from the same participant give the same binary recommendation
  case_concordance <- df_multi_pred %>%
    group_by(case_ID) %>%
    summarise(
      n_scrollsets = n(),
      n_distinct_recommendations = n_distinct(pred_class),
      complete_concordance = n_distinct_recommendations == 1,
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  tibble(
    model = model_name,
    threshold = threshold,
    n_participants_with_multiple_scrollsets = n_distinct(df_multi$case_ID),
    n_scrollsets_from_multi_scrollset_participants = nrow(df_multi),
    complete_concordance_n = sum(case_concordance$complete_concordance),
    complete_concordance_percent = 100 * mean(case_concordance$complete_concordance),
    discordant_n = sum(!case_concordance$complete_concordance)
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Run  concordance analysis
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

repro_simple_summary <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  repro_model_features,
  ~ run_simple_concordance(
    df_all = repro_df,
    df_multi = repro_multi_df,
    features = .x,
    model_name = .y
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    threshold = round(threshold, 3),
    complete_concordance_percent = round(complete_concordance_percent, 1)
  )

cat("\n--- Within-participant concordance summary ---\n")
print(repro_simple_summary, n = Inf, width = Inf)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Export summary table
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

repro_output_dir <- if (exists("data_dir")) data_dir else "."

write.csv(
  repro_simple_summary,
  file = file.path(
    repro_output_dir,
    "within_participant_scrollset_concordance_summary.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```


```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# 16. Covariate-adjusted feature-wise ORs per SD increase
#
# Each model:
#   outcome_binary ~ one_genomic_feature + age + sex + smoking_status
# ==============================================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(purrr)
library(geepack)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Define required variables
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

adjusted_or_required_vars <- c(
  "case_ID",
  "endoscopy_outcome_binarized",
  "age",
  "sex",
  "smoking_binary",
  "genome_wide_CNA_burden",
  "chr2q",
  "chr3q",
  "chr9p",
  "chr11q"
)

missing_adjusted_or_vars <- setdiff(adjusted_or_required_vars, names(model_df))

if (length(missing_adjusted_or_vars) > 0) {
  stop(
    "The following variables are missing from model_df: ",
    paste(missing_adjusted_or_vars, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Prepare dataframe
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

adjusted_or_df <- model_df %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(adjusted_or_required_vars)) %>%
  mutate(
    outcome_binary = case_when(
      endoscopy_outcome_binarized == "X1" ~ 1,
      endoscopy_outcome_binarized == "X0" ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    age = as.numeric(age),
    
    sex = case_when(
      as.character(sex) %in% c("F", "Female", "female") ~ "Female",
      as.character(sex) %in% c("M", "Male", "male") ~ "Male",
      TRUE ~ as.character(sex)
    ),
    sex = factor(
      sex,
      levels = c("Female", "Male")
    ),
    
    smoking_status = case_when(
      as.character(smoking_binary) %in% c("0", "Never", "never", "NEVER") ~ "Never",
      as.character(smoking_binary) %in% c("1", "Active", "active", "Former", "former", "active/former", "Active/former") ~ "Active/former",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    smoking_status = factor(
      smoking_status,
      levels = c("Never", "Active/former")
    ),
    
    cluster_id = as.integer(factor(case_ID))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(outcome_binary))

cat("\n--- Adjusted OR dataset before feature-wise complete-case filtering ---\n")
print(
  adjusted_or_df %>%
    summarise(
      n_scrollsets = n(),
      n_patients = n_distinct(case_ID),
      n_IEN_early_cancer_scrollsets = sum(outcome_binary == 1),
      n_non_IEN_early_cancer_scrollsets = sum(outcome_binary == 0),
      n_IEN_early_cancer_patients = n_distinct(case_ID[outcome_binary == 1]),
      n_non_IEN_early_cancer_patients = n_distinct(case_ID[outcome_binary == 0]),
      n_missing_age = sum(is.na(age)),
      n_missing_sex = sum(is.na(sex)),
      n_missing_smoking = sum(is.na(smoking_status))
    )
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Define genomic features
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

genomic_features <- c(
  "genome_wide_CNA_burden",
  "chr2q",
  "chr3q",
  "chr9p",
  "chr11q"
)

genomic_feature_labels <- c(
  "genome_wide_CNA_burden" = "Genome-wide CNA burden",
  "chr2q" = "2q arm-level copy-number signal",
  "chr3q" = "3q arm-level copy-number signal",
  "chr9p" = "9p arm-level copy-number signal",
  "chr11q" = "11q arm-level copy-number signal"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Function to fit one feature-wise adjusted GEE model
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

fit_feature_wise_adjusted_or <- function(df, feature_name) {
  
  feature_label <- genomic_feature_labels[[feature_name]]
  
  feature_model_df <- df %>%
    dplyr::select(
      case_ID,
      cluster_id,
      outcome_binary,
      age,
      sex,
      smoking_status,
      all_of(feature_name)
    ) %>%
    tidyr::drop_na() %>%
    mutate(
      genomic_feature_raw = .data[[feature_name]],
      genomic_feature_sd = sd(genomic_feature_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
    ) %>%
    arrange(cluster_id)
  
  cat("\n--- Running feature-wise adjusted model for: ", feature_label, " ---\n")
  print(
    feature_model_df %>%
      summarise(
        n_scrollsets = n(),
        n_patients = n_distinct(case_ID),
        n_IEN_early_cancer_scrollsets = sum(outcome_binary == 1),
        n_non_IEN_early_cancer_scrollsets = sum(outcome_binary == 0),
        n_IEN_early_cancer_patients = n_distinct(case_ID[outcome_binary == 1]),
        n_non_IEN_early_cancer_patients = n_distinct(case_ID[outcome_binary == 0]),
        feature_sd = first(genomic_feature_sd)
      )
  )
  
  if (nrow(feature_model_df) == 0) {
    stop("No complete-case rows available for feature: ", feature_name)
  }
  
  if (n_distinct(feature_model_df$case_ID) != n_distinct(feature_model_df$cluster_id)) {
    stop("Cluster ID problem for feature: ", feature_name)
  }
  
  feature_formula <- as.formula(
    paste(
      "outcome_binary ~",
      feature_name,
      "+ age + sex + smoking_status"
    )
  )
  
  gee_fit <- geepack::geeglm(
    formula = feature_formula,
    id = cluster_id,
    data = feature_model_df,
    family = binomial(link = "logit"),
    corstr = "independence",
    control = geepack::geese.control(maxit = 100)
  )
  
  coef_table <- as.data.frame(summary(gee_fit)$coefficients) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("term")
  
  names(coef_table) <- make.names(names(coef_table))
  
  p_col <- grep("^Pr", names(coef_table), value = TRUE)[1]
  
  feature_row <- coef_table %>%
    filter(term == feature_name)
  
  raw_estimate <- feature_row$Estimate
  raw_robust_se <- feature_row$Std.err
  raw_p_value <- feature_row[[p_col]]
  feature_sd <- unique(feature_model_df$genomic_feature_sd)
  
  log_or_per_sd <- raw_estimate * feature_sd
  robust_se_per_sd <- raw_robust_se * feature_sd
  
  adjusted_or_per_sd <- exp(log_or_per_sd)
  ci_lower <- exp(log_or_per_sd - 1.96 * robust_se_per_sd)
  ci_upper <- exp(log_or_per_sd + 1.96 * robust_se_per_sd)
  
  tibble(
    biomarker = feature_label,
    biomarker_variable = feature_name,
    scale = "Per 1 SD increase",
    adjusted_or_per_sd = adjusted_or_per_sd,
    ci_lower = ci_lower,
    ci_upper = ci_upper,
    p_value = raw_p_value,
    feature_sd = feature_sd,
    n_scrollsets = nrow(feature_model_df),
    n_patients = n_distinct(feature_model_df$case_ID),
    n_IEN_early_cancer_scrollsets = sum(feature_model_df$outcome_binary == 1),
    n_non_IEN_early_cancer_scrollsets = sum(feature_model_df$outcome_binary == 0),
    n_IEN_early_cancer_patients = n_distinct(feature_model_df$case_ID[feature_model_df$outcome_binary == 1]),
    n_non_IEN_early_cancer_patients = n_distinct(feature_model_df$case_ID[feature_model_df$outcome_binary == 0]),
    adjusted_for = "Age, sex and smoking status",
    model = "Feature-wise GEE using raw genomic feature values",
    raw_log_or = raw_estimate,
    raw_robust_se = raw_robust_se,
    log_or_per_sd = log_or_per_sd,
    robust_se_per_sd = robust_se_per_sd
  )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Run feature-wise adjusted models
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

supplementary_table4_feature_wise <- purrr::map_dfr(
  genomic_features,
  ~ fit_feature_wise_adjusted_or(
    df = adjusted_or_df,
    feature_name = .x
  )
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Format Supplementary Table 4
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

supplementary_table4_feature_wise_formatted <- supplementary_table4_feature_wise %>%
  mutate(
    adjusted_or_95ci = paste0(
      sprintf("%.2f", adjusted_or_per_sd),
      " (",
      sprintf("%.2f", ci_lower),
      "–",
      sprintf("%.2f", ci_upper),
      ")"
    ),
    p_value_fmt = case_when(
      is.na(p_value) ~ NA_character_,
      p_value < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
      TRUE ~ sprintf("%.3f", p_value)
    ),
    feature_sd = round(feature_sd, 4)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    biomarker,
    scale,
    adjusted_or_95ci,
    p_value = p_value_fmt,
    feature_sd,
    n_scrollsets,
    n_patients,
    n_IEN_early_cancer_scrollsets,
    n_non_IEN_early_cancer_scrollsets,
    n_IEN_early_cancer_patients,
    n_non_IEN_early_cancer_patients,
    adjusted_for,
    model,
    biomarker_variable,
    raw_log_or,
    raw_robust_se,
    log_or_per_sd,
    robust_se_per_sd
  )

cat("\n--- Supplementary Table 4: Feature-wise covariate-adjusted ORs per SD increase ---\n")
print(supplementary_table4_feature_wise_formatted, n = Inf, width = Inf)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Save Supplementary Table 4
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

supp_table4_output_dir <- if (exists("data_dir")) data_dir else "."

write.csv(
  supplementary_table4_feature_wise_formatted,
  file = file.path(
    supp_table4_output_dir,
    "Supplementary_Table4_feature_wise_covariate_adjusted_ORs_per_SD.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\nSaved Supplementary Table 4 to: ", supp_table4_output_dir, "\n")
```

```{r}
  "chr14q",
  "chr15q",
  "chr16p", "chr16q",
  "chr17p", "chr17q",
  "chr18p", "chr18q",
  "chr19p", "chr19q",
  "chr20p", "chr20q",
  "chr21q",
  "chr22q"
)

spec_order_df_allarms <- arm_level_annot %>%
  mutate(
    original_row_order = row_number(),
    group = case_when(
      as.character(endoscopy_outcome_trichotomize) == "0" ~ "Normal",
      as.character(endoscopy_outcome_trichotomize) == "0.5" ~ "Benign",
      as.character(endoscopy_outcome_trichotomize) == "1" ~ "IEN/early cancer",
      as.character(endoscopy_outcome_trichotomize) == "Normal" ~ "Normal",
      as.character(endoscopy_outcome_trichotomize) == "Benign" ~ "Benign",
      as.character(endoscopy_outcome_trichotomize) == "IEN/early cancer" ~ "IEN/early cancer",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(group)) %>%
  distinct(specimen_ID, group, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, levels = c("Normal", "Benign", "IEN/early cancer"))
  ) %>%
  arrange(group, original_row_order) %>%
  mutate(
    specimen_ID = factor(specimen_ID, levels = unique(specimen_ID))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(specimen_ID, group)

# --- Prepare all-arm plotting dataframe ---
all_arm_bubble_df <- arm_level_annot %>%
  mutate(
    group = case_when(
      as.character(endoscopy_outcome_trichotomize) == "0" ~ "Normal",
      as.character(endoscopy_outcome_trichotomize) == "0.5" ~ "Benign",
      as.character(endoscopy_outcome_trichotomize) == "1" ~ "IEN/early cancer",
      as.character(endoscopy_outcome_trichotomize) == "Normal" ~ "Normal",
      as.character(endoscopy_outcome_trichotomize) == "Benign" ~ "Benign",
      as.character(endoscopy_outcome_trichotomize) == "IEN/early cancer" ~ "IEN/early cancer",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(group),
    chromosomal_arm %in% chromosomal_arm_order
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    chromosomal_arm = factor(chromosomal_arm, levels = chromosomal_arm_order),
    group = factor(group, levels = c("Normal", "Benign", "IEN/early cancer"))
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    spec_order_df_allarms,
    by = c("specimen_ID", "group")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    specimen_ID = factor(specimen_ID, levels = levels(spec_order_df_allarms$specimen_ID))
  )

# --- Quick checks ---

--- All-arm bubble plot dataframe checks ---
")
cat("Number of rows:
")

Outcome group counts based on specimen IDs:

    count(group, name = "n_specimens"),

)

Number of unique specimens:
")

cat("
Number of unique chromosome arms:
")

# --- Plot ---
extended_all_arm_bubbles <- ggplot(
  all_arm_bubble_df,
  aes(

    size = pmin(0.35, abs(segmented_CN)),

  geom_point(

  ) +

  ) +

    name = "Relative copy number (log2)"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = NULL,
    x = "Chromosome arm",
    y = "Capsule sponge specimens"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing.y = unit(0.35, "lines"),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(colour = "grey80", linewidth = 0.25),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 90,
      vjust = 0.5,

      size = 9,

    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9, margin = margin(r = 5)),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    legend.position = "right",

    legend.title.align = 0,

    legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9)
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.03, 0.03))) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(add = c(0.5, 0.5))) +

      keywidth = unit(2.2, "mm"),
      keyheight = unit(2.2, "mm"),
      override.aes = list(stroke = 0.18, alpha = 0.9)
    )
  )
```
